newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway's central bank raises key interest rates.
newsitem.headline: Norway's central bank raises key interest rates.

text.p: Norway's central bank said on Wednesday it was raising its key interest rates by 0.25 percentage points in response to recent developments in money and foreign exchange markets.

The bank increased its deposit rate, the credit rate, to 3.50 percent from 3.25 percent. The overnight lending rate, charged to commercial and savings banks, was raised to 5.50 percent from 5.25 percent.
